programme.title: 爆谷製造 -回望秋名山飛車歲月
programme.desc: Celebrating the 20th anniversary of release of the classic film 'Initial D', Director Andrew Lau fondly recalls his first impression on Jay Chou that had been completely changed after an incident and also reveals how dangerous when Jay crashed the AE86 on set. In this episode, the film's creative team looks back on the unforgettable moments of the filming day and reveal to us the unknown behind-the-scenes stories.

programme.title: 車手
programme.desc: Sean is an overconfident rookie in Stealth Riders, a secret police unit consisting of the best drivers in the force that targets against underworld racing and fugitives on the run. Jensen is a legendary escape driver for criminals, who had never been caught before his retirement 15 years ago. When Sean chances upon Jensen out of the blue one day, he thinks his day has finally come..

programme.title: 搶紅
programme.desc: Shui Zhang and Waley were buddies at an orphanage. Adopted by a French couple and moved to France at a young age, Waley has become a wine connoisseur prodigy. Left alone in China, Shui Zhang grows up to be a braggart and a nobody. When Shui Zhang travels to France one day to enlist Waley's help in auctioning a bottle of red wine called 'The God of Wine,' said to contain Kublai Khan's secret wine-brewing recipe, Waley accepted the challenge in a heartbeat. During the auction, Waley encounters a representative from the seller, the beautiful Yvonne, and falls in love with her at first sight. The other potential buyer is the wealthy and imposing coal tycoon Changfang Fang. While he appears to be a rich and vulgar brute on the surface, he is much more than meets the eyes. Adding to the mystery is the private connoisseur of suspicious origins following Fang everywhere. To Waley's surprise, Zhang and Fang seem to be sharing secrets between themselves. The group of buyers set off an.

programme.title: 浪漫特攻隊
programme.desc: Yeo-rae is a retired national superstar in Korea. During her holiday on a South Pacific Island, she gets married to Jonathan, a tycoon who she initially thought of as her prince charming but turns out to be a control freak. With the help of her neighbour Beom-wu, who happens to be a die-hard fan of Yeo-rae, she is going to get herself out of the cage with a murder plan.

programme.title: 為你鍾情
programme.desc: Winnie never knows her mother. Ever since she was a toddler, her father and scientist grandfather had weaved the tale that she works for Santa Claus. Not until Winnie turns twenty does the incredible truth finally dawns on her, when she accidentally opens a freezing chamber in his grandfather's laboratory and resurrects a mysterious young woman inside. This woman is none other than Winnie's long lost mother, Gigi, who, unbeknownst to her daughter, has been cyronically frozen since a fatal car accident twenty years ago. Still very much a teenager, Gigi is shaken not only by the presence of a daughter physically older than her but also by the devastating news that her idol Leslie Cheung has passed away during her long slumber. To make up for lost time, she sets off with Winnie in search of her boyfriend, Kit, who happens to be Winnie's biological father. The Kit that Gigi used to know was a dashingly handsome young man fully convinced he would become a pop star some day. When G.

programme.title: 爆谷製造 -陳可辛的奪冠夢
programme.desc: Baogu Produces: The Champion Dream of Peter Ho-sun Chan (Full Ver.) is a sit down interview with the film's director to unveil the most anticipated questions for Peter Ho-sun Chan's box office hit LEAP, which is one of the contenders for the 93rd Academy Awards' Best International Feature Film competition.

programme.title: 奪冠
programme.desc: With glorious days from five consecutive championships in the 1980s, the Women's National Volleyball Team of China had transcended the conventional definition of sports in the hearts of Chinese people. When the Chinese team was pitted against the US team led by Lang Ping at the 2008 Beijing Volleyball Game, everyone knew that it was a match that China could not lose, and certainly could not afford to lose. Defeated, the Chinese team plunged into the deepest abyss in three decades. As Lang Ping returned to her country to coach the team, many mused aloud as to whether China's Women's National Volleyball Team would be able to retrieve lost grounds. The film recounts the ups and downs, the sweat and sacrifice of the team over the past four decades. While the team's persistence and teamwork became a national inspiration and collective memory in the 80s, whether the team spirit can be passed down to the new generation as China goes through rapid changes.

programme.title: 手捲煙
programme.desc: Former Hong Kong Military Service Corps officer becomes caught in a triad manhunt when he takes in an ethnic South Asian man carrying a bag of stolen drugs. Forced to live under the same roof, the two men transcend their cultural and racial differences to form a beautiful friendship in this poignant tale of loyalty and brotherhood.

programme.title: 片場職人 -吳君如
programme.desc: In the second part of the interview, Sandra Ng revisits some of her early iconic comedies and tells how the giddy on-screen persona was established turning her to stay on the path of a comedian. She also gives a peek into her inner world as a female creator, unveiling the true side of this highly influential comedy actress.

programme.title: 驅魔黑修女
programme.desc: Are you ready to venture into the forbidden? Sister Giunia is convinced that the evil spirit possessing Hee-joon is one of the 12 Manifestations. With the exorcist priest unable to come in time and Hee-joon's life clearly at risk, Sister Giunia decides to break a sacred rule: ‘An unordained nun cannot perform an exorcism.' However, Father Paolo, Hee-joon's attending physician, firmly believes that only medicine can save the boy. When Sister Giunia discovers a secret about Father Paolo's disciple, Sister Michela, she recklessly seeks her help to smuggle Hee-joon out of the hospital. Despite clashing with the fearless Giunia, Michela, feeling a connection to the boy, decides to join forces. Together, the two nuns embark on a dangerous ritual, determined to save the boy at all costs, no matter the risks or consequences. There's only one rule: Save him at all cost.

programme.title: 門徒
programme.desc: Nick is undercover in Asia's crime trade as he plays protege to a key player, 'Banker', for 8 years. However, as He is more trusted by Banker, he finds himself gradually corrupted..

programme.title: 重案行動之搗毒任務
programme.desc: A young girl died of drug addiction, revealing that a new type of drug is spreading rapidly in Hong Kong, affecting young people. The police take the incident seriously and set up an elite team from various departments to eradicate the entire drug cartel. The team investigated from various aspects of tracking, undercover, and forensics, and finally found that the mastermind behind turned out to be a genius drug refiner.

programme.title: 本日公休
programme.desc: For forty years A-Rui has been running a barbershop, a small place where she has seen happiness and sorrow, ebb and flow. Faced with all the troubles in her life, A-Rui fully commits to her work and defeat is never an option for her, but her children never appreciate it and treat her profession with disdain. One day, A-Rui receives a phone call from the family of an old regular client who moved far away a long time ago. The family asks A-Rui if she would be willing to travel to cut the hair for the bedridden old man. Reminded of what her master taught her, “Always provide your best service,” A-Rui decides to hang up the “Day Off” sign and closes her shop for one day. She drives her beat-up old car and embarks on a long journey to do something others think is not worthwhile.

programme.title: 春心萌動的老屋緣廊
programme.desc: Age is just a number when it comes to being a BL fan! 75-year-old widow Yuki (Nobuko Miyamoto) picks up a boys' love manga one day and it opens her eyes to a new world. At the bookstore, she meets shy 17-year-old schoolgirl Urara (Mana Ashida) who reads BL on the sly. Happily reading and discussing BL together, they forge a congenial bond that heals loneliness and unlocks their inner hopes and fears. Seasoned TV director Shunsuke Kariyama (Love's in Sight) and screenwriter Yoshikazu Okada (The 8-Year Engagement) adapt Kaori Tsurutani's award-winning manga into a heartwarming, female-centric human drama about an unlikely friendship that inspires comfort and change.

programme.title: 異山怪談
programme.desc: Members of 'GO2MOUNTAIN' bike riding club try valleys of Mount CHIAK where unreal too-cleanly-cut mutilation murders happened. Moments of freedom riding the mountain, odd things happen around them. Will they survive through what that haunts.

programme.title: 一念無明
programme.desc: The film begins with an old man who has long been absent as a father, picking up his son, who is suffering from bipolar disorder, from a mental hospital. Both men are in deep remorse for the accident that caused the death of the mother. The tension and anxiety boil as they stay with each other in a tiny subdivided flat. As time passes, they realize the pain between one another is not the only confrontation that awaits them; but to face the cruel world that they are living in.

programme.title: 兒蹤
programme.desc: April is a beloved 8-year-old daughter of Pij and Ake. Unfortunately, she is kidnapped mysteriously and Pij dedicates her life to finding her missing daughter. One day there is a burnt corpse of a girl and the only thing left is a small piece of fabric that matches April's cloth on the day she disappeared. The DNA result from the fabric proves that it matches 95% of April's DNA. Pij doesn't believe that it is April's corpse and continues searching for her daughter. Pij hires Tan, who used to work for a Missing Children Foundation. Pij has hope again until they meet a psycho man who brutally kidnaps children. The life-threatening struggle to find the truth; therefore, begins..

programme.title: 鐵道英雄
programme.desc: Winter in 1939, southern Shandong Province, railway workers Hong and Wang led a guerrilla force active on the railway line. In a snowy night, Hong led a group of people, including Qi Lu and Lin Dong, to assassinate three senior Japanese officials, which enraged the Japanese army. Fujiwara, a senior Japanese agent, arrived discreetly and had initiated an investigation. The railway squad and Fujiwara went head-to-head with rounds of hard battles, during which the railway squad sacrificed three members and Wang's undercover identity was revealed. At this time, a train carrying crucial Japanese armaments was about to pass by, and the railway crew members chose to step up and fight the enemy to the death at this vital juncture.

programme.title: 救參的士
programme.desc: In 1987, diplomat 'Min-jun' was unable to escape the Middle East Department at the Ministry of Foreign Affairs for five years. One day, he receives a coded message from a missing diplomat in Lebanon, who was kidnapped 20 months ago. Filled with hopeful aspirations of a promotion to the United States if successful, he volunteers for an unofficial mission to rescue his colleague and heads to Lebanon. Upon arrival at the airport, 'Min-jun' narrowly avoids a hail of bullets from airport security guards who are after his life. By chance, he ends up getting into the car of a Korean taxi driver named 'Pan-su'. With local gangsters hot on their heels attempting to steal the ransom money, 'Min-jun' has no choice but to rely on expat Pan-su, the only fellow Korean around. However, can this shady character, who will do anything for money, truly help in rescuing his colleague.

programme.title: 此情此刻
programme.desc: 'The Moment' talks about four relationships - A couple breaking up yet holding tight; a father and a daughter meeting up after a long separation; a girl escaping from growing up; and two buddies' reunion after years of misunderstanding. Different people carry different stories. The stories are connected by a vintage photography studio holder. Their experiences bring out a variety of sensations to the city we are living in; these feelings belong to them, and also us.

programme.title: 長夜盡頭的微光
programme.desc: After a series of mishaps at work caused by her severe pre-menstrual syndrome, Fujisawa lands a new job at an astronomical toy factory, where she meets Yamazoe, a tacit colleague plagued by panic attacks. There the two, whose careers have been derailed by their respective conditions, learn to support and care for each other through life's ups and downs despite their initial friction.

programme.title: 狄仁傑之四大天王
programme.desc: Mysterious events keep happening in Luoyang: warriors wearing totem masks perpetrate crime all around the city; the fox outside the bar begins to speak human language; dragons on the column of the palace come alive; the Heavenly Kings in the temple show its angry face. Dee needs to solve the puzzles behind the mysterious cases, while facing obstacles from Empress Wu.

programme.title: 送院途中
programme.desc: After being reassigned to a new station along with his superior, Rock Sir, paramedic Wong Wai is assigned to ride with Jerry Ma. At first, Wai is worried that his work performance review would be affected because he doesn't agree with Jerry's way of working. But after some time, Jerry influences Wai to remember once again that the aim of paramedic work is to save every victim. Meanwhile, Jerry, a single father, is hesitating over the future of his daughter, Bonnie. He can't bear to see her leave, but he finally decides to send Bonnie to Canada for schooling. Before she leaves, she tells Jerry that she's worried about being forgotten when she's in Canada, just like her late mother was forgotten. Jerry tries to explain himself, but it's hard to digest such long-gestating grief. At the same time, a serious traffic accident occurs on Tuen Mun highway. Jerry immediately rushes to the scene for the rescue effort. When Wai notices that Rock Sir cares more about taking over command t.

programme.title: 殺出個黃昏
programme.desc: Last generation of assassins moved to HK in 50/60's and posted as “killer-for-hire' trio to fix all sort of problems for their clients. Decades passed, they now become redundant themselves at work and home. An accidental mission calls upon them turns out to be an assisted suicide. The trio suddenly finds new ‘life'.....as ”Guardian Angels of the Elders”. Just when they are finding meanings to this new role, an order from a teenager turns their new practice upside down again......this might as well be their very last job.

programme.title: 怒潮
programme.desc: Amid the transfer of power at the Hongtai Group, which wields influence in both the lawful and unlawful worlds, a mysterious assassin named Chen An suddenly enters this vortex of confusion and throws the Hongtai Group into chaos. Mai Longwen from the police and Ma Wenkang from the gangs both have their eyes on him... Various forces are waiting for the opportunity to strike. Who is the mastermind behind the scenes? A fierce battle is about to break out.

programme.title: 臥底型警 FINAL
programme.desc: Reiji Kikukawa graduated from the police academy with the worst record in its history. One day out of the blue, this straightforward, overly hot-blooded cop with a weakness for women is assigned to an undercover investigation as “The Mole”! He is ordered to infiltrate Japan's most feared yakuza organization in order to arrest its leader, Shuho Todoroki. Reiji goes deep undercover and his final mission is to stop the biggest illegal drug trade in history worth USD 6 billion which takes place on a luxury cruise ship sailing around the world.

programme.title: 低一點的天空
programme.desc: Fat Cat, a nickname because of his chubby body, is a moderately mentally handicapped person. He works happily and passionately as a delivery boy in a restaurant. Little Cheung is a spastic with normal IQ working as an office boy. Fairy Snow White, name it after a renowned Chinese opera actress, is a blissful, middle-class daughter. Her bright future suddenly turned vague when she became blind at age twelve. From then on, she is living in the dark, but her childhood memories enable her to live in peace and harmony. Fat Cat, Little Cheung and Snow White become good friends afterwards, sharing their respective dream. They don't think it is feasible except Fat Cat does..

programme.title: 怪物
programme.desc: When her young son Minato starts to behave strangely, his mother feels that there is something wrong. Discovering that a teacher is responsible, she storms into the school demanding to know what's going on. But as the story unfolds through the eyes of mother, teacher and child, the truth gradually emerges.

programme.title: 爆谷電影現場
programme.desc: Baogu At The Movie brings you the most exclusive behind the scenes of recent local blockbusters. The most true story and sincere conversation behind every piece of dreamwork.

programme.title: 一點就到家
programme.desc: This is a youth-comedy version of American Dreams in China (2013). Wei Jinbei (played by Liu Haoran), Peng Xiubing (Peng Yuchang) and Li Shaoqun (Yin Fang) are young men of very different personalities. One had tried many times to find success in e-commerce but had failed on every turn in a big city. The other is a village lad, with nothing on his mind but the chase for success. The third one is consumed by romantic visions of life, divorced entirely from reality. They had separately returned from the city to an antiquated town in Yunnan. Brought together by fate, they decided to launch an e-commerce business together. They might have stumbled upon a great idea, but the state-of-the-art nature of their technological pursuit puts them at odds with the fogeyish ways of the very traditional town. With resolve and sincerity, they managed to win over everyone, entering into the eventful journey of a tech startup, a journey at once earnest, vibrant and surreal.

programme.title: 解碼追兇劇場版
programme.desc: In 2021, a limousine taxi driver causes an accident on a highway and a high-level government official dies in the accident. Cold case investigation team, including Kento Saegusa and team leader Misaki Sakurai, have doubts about the case. Meanwhile, in 2009, administrative officers die consecutively in car accidents. The police announce these deaths as accidents. Takeshi Ooyama believes that these deaths were not the product of simple accidents. At 11:23 PM, a walkie-talkie turns on and makes a connection between the future and past. Kento Saegusa and Takeshi Ooyama face the threat of bioterrorism..

programme.title: 別叫我“賭神
programme.desc: Water Ng, a typical loser who likes to gamble and takes no responsibility is asked to take care of his ex-girlfriend Jik's son, Yeung. With Jik tells him that Yeung is his son, and promised 100 thousand dollars, Water Ng agrees to be a father for one month. Soon he notices his son has Autism. He gets to understand the difficulties of raising a child along with special needs. With Jik's absence on the agreed date, Water Ng realizes why she brought him his blood. He finds his life goal while discovering Yeung's talent on the racing field, then decides to get rid of the dissipated life and accompany his son spreading wings for the dream.

programme.title: 某日某月
programme.desc: In 1992, a heavy rainstorm caused massive power outage in Hong Kong. At that night, two young astrology enthusiasts, Moon and Sun, met under the starry night by the seaside. When their affection to each other grew, Sun was admitted into a boarding school and would move to another country in a few months under his father's plan. Like the sun and moon, the couple could hardly see each other despite that they were living in the same city, but their love endured amidst the separation and opposition from Moon's mother. Overcoming the challenges from teachers, friends and family, time has come for Sun to depart..

programme.title: 爆谷電影現場
programme.desc: Baogu At The Movie brings you the most exclusive behind the scenes of recent local blockbusters. The most true story and sincere conversation behind every piece of dreamwork.

programme.title: 與神同行：終極審判
programme.desc: Su-hong and his 3 Afterlife Guardians journey through 7 hells in order for all them to be reincarnated, while a household god defies all rules to help ordinary people in the living world. And the afterlife guardian's tragic lives on earth thousand years ago are uncovered one by one during their battle against the god in human world.

programme.title: LAST MILE：全面引爆
programme.desc: On the day before the Black Friday sale, a box delivered by a global e-commerce company, explodes. The box was sent from one of the biggest warehouses, which has the three-quarter logistic shares around Tokyo. It leads a series of mysterious bombings that terrorize whole of Japan. Elena Funado, who was just appointed as a new director of the warehouse, is forced to control this unprecedented situation with a line manager, Ko Nashimoto. Who planted the bombs? For what purpose? How many bombs are left? - And where are they now? In this modern society, distribution service becomes critical need for our lives and that cannot be stopped. Can Elena and Ko end the serial bombings without stopping blood flowed in “blood vessel”; the global logistics system like a web.

programme.title: 三不管
programme.desc: In one of the darkest and diverse cultural part in the city, there is a minority group who lives in the place where it is full of despair and frustration. At first glance, their desperate living comprises illegal gambling, prostitution as well as drug-dealing. Indeed, their way of living is guided by their own norms and laws, regardless of the entrenched ones prevailing in the general public. Although their norms are chaotic and arbitrary, they do not violate the existence of the conventional ones. Consequently, it can be said that this chaotic region is unique within the city. On one occasion, there are two men, riding in a vehicle, unexpectedly enter this restricted region..

programme.title: 片場職人 -譚耀文
programme.desc: Patrick Tam started as a singer, who had been embracing a dream in films, later successfully turned into actor after the film “Beast Cops”. Having played antagonists throughout the years, how does he feel towards the ‘Villain Label'? In this episode, Patrick shares his experience in portraying different roles, the change in mindset after becoming an actor as well about his life insights.

programme.title: Z風暴
programme.desc: This may be the most critical corruption case since ICAC was established for forty years, involving enormous corruption group; include retired senior governor, senior police officer, business millionaire, senior Attorney and so on. Confronting such Tenacious enemies, ICAC's investigators never give up; they use technology, internet and psychological skills to fight back, and meanwhile they try their best to protect themselves from being killed by professional killers..

programme.title: 屍殺列車
programme.desc: A mysterious viral outbreak pushes Korea into a state of emergency! As an unidentified virus sweeps the country, Korean government declares martial law. Those on an express train to Busan, a city that has successfully fended off the viral outbreak, must fight for their own survival... 453 km from Seoul to Busan. The struggle to survive by those who have others to protect! Get on board to stay alive.

programme.title: 回憶三部曲
programme.desc: From the creative supervision of Katsuhiro OTOMO ('STEAMBOY', 'SHORT PEACE'), comes 'MEMORIES', a three-part work based on OTOMO's three original stories. ('MAGNETIC ROSE') Set in outer space at the end of the 21st century, the 1st part tells the story of two engineers who encounter the apparition of a female opera singer in an abandoned space freighter... ('STINK BOMB') The 2nd story is a satirical tale of a young lab technician who accidentally swallows experimental pills... ('CANNON FODDER') The 3rd part depicts war-time life in an imaginary world, using a characteristic camerawork.

credits.director: 大友克洋, 森本晃司, 岡村天齋

programme.title: 國產凌凌漆
programme.desc: In Beijing a man with a golden gun steals the cranium bones of China's only dinosaur fossil. Stephen, the Chinese 007 with license to kiss and kill, is sent to Hong Kong.

programme.title: 我在時間盡頭等你
programme.desc: Some lives are linked across time, connected by destiny. While aiding an old theatre attendant Lin Ge (Lee Hongchi), aspiring dancer Qiu Qian (Li Yitong) stumbles upon his diary which chronicles the life and memories they shared together since childhood, thus discovering a timeless love story concealed in another dimension.

programme.title: 快一秒的他
programme.desc: Hajime is a handsome young man, who is always a second quicker than everyone else. He works at the post office, where Reika comes to buy a stamp every day. Reika is a young woman, who is always a second slower than everyone else. On the day after Valentine's Day, Hajime wakes up to find himself losing all his memories from the previous day... A remake of the Best Film Winner at the Taipei Golden Horse Awards, My Missing Valentine, and relocating the story to Kyoto, the film tells a quirky romance caught in unexpected time differences.

programme.title: 惡行之外
programme.desc: One rainy night, the dead body of a girl, the only daughter of Hong Kong police Yin Lok, is found in the wild. Polices based on clues, suspect has been identified. However, several more girls are murdered and murder cases keep happening. Yin begins to investigate his daughter's death and met a mentally retarded girls, he is looking for more clues from this special girl. Finally, Yin is getting closer to the truth..

programme.title: 沒有美色殺人狂
programme.desc: 'Do we lacking anything? We have a house, a truck, and very attractive.' Self-proclaimed tough guy Jae-pil and sexy guy Sang-gu leave an unforgettable first impression on their moving day. Despite becoming special surveillance targets for Police Chief Choi and Officer Nam, they are simply happy to start anew in their European-style dream house. However, happiness is short-lived as they are inadvertently mistaken for kidnappers while trying to rescue Mina, who almost drowns. Meanwhile, uninvited guests looking for Mina start appearing, and an ancient spirit sealed in the basement awakens, surrounding the house with dark energy.

programme.title: 爆谷巨星匯：任達華: Mrs. K
programme.desc: Mrs. K is a housewife who lives in a quiet suburban neighborhood with her husband Mr. K and their daughter Lil' K. One day, a Macau ex-cop shows up to blackmail Mrs. K. He knows about her unseemly past. She agrees to his term and they meet. The deal goes sour as she attempts to get rid of him. He escapes and is captured by a stranger. After finding out why Ex-cop is mixed up in this, the stranger kills him. They are after Mrs. K for different reasons. Ex-cop is someone who stumbles upon Mrs. K's identity and decides to try his luck. The stranger, however, bears a grudge against Mrs. K. Things would date back more than ten years ago when a Macau casino was robbed. The robbery was carried out by a band of professionals and was led by none other than Mrs. K..

programme.title: 劍雨
programme.desc: In 428AD, Bodhi, Prince of Southern India, becomes a Buddhist monk and sets off for China, earning a hallowed reputation as a mystical martial artist. Following his death, his remains mysteriously disappear. It is rumored that his remains contain the secret to obtaining limitless power and ruling the martial arts world. Centuries later, The Dark Stone emerges as a team of deadly assassins; their best assassin is the ruthless, invincible Drizzle. On her latest mission, Drizzle takes out Zhang Haiduan, a high-ranking court official. Zhang's son, Renfeng, while mourning his father's death, is also attacked and seemingly killed by Drizzle and her fellow assassins. Drizzle's life changes when she kills Lu Zhu, a monk with whom she has unintentionally fallen in love..

programme.title: 爆谷製造 -填詞人填詞魂
programme.desc: The director-screenwriter Norris Wong together with the main cast Chung Suet Ying and Eric Kot share funny stories on the set of their latest collaboration The Lyricist Wannabe. In the face of this young energetic crew composed of several rookie actors, Eric exposes himself having difficulty to recognize faces! As Norris and Suet Ying both find Ansonbean's lively character impressive, what exactly he did to catch their attentions? In real life, three of them are all experienced in lyric writing; yet how the writing method of Suet Ying and Eric turn out completely different from that shown in the movie? Let's now see these insiders reveal more behind-the-scene stories.

programme.title: 填詞L
programme.desc: Believing that writing Cantopop is her God-given talent, Law Wing-sze decides to make it her lifelong career. But as hard as Sze tries to polish her lyrics writing skills and expand her social circle, nothing seems to go her way. What if there's a will, but there's no way? The first major motion picture about Cantopop lyrics writing. Norris Wong's long-awaited follow-up to her acclaimed debut My Prince Edward is an unsentimental autobiographical dramedy that reminds us no dream is guaranteed to come true. Ironically, the film's star, up-and-coming actress Chung Suet-ying, is actually a real-life Cantopop lyricist.

programme.title: 盲探
programme.desc: The crime-solver in the Police Crime Unit CHONG was forced to quit four years ago after he got blind accidentally and since then has worked as a private eye on cold cases to earn rewards for a living. He has spent nine months investigating the suspect for the Mongkok Acid Attack Case but was caught in a dire situation during an operation. Fortunately he was saved by a woman detective TUNG in the nick of time..

programme.title: 爆谷獨家首播：天降異能必有用: 超能神探
programme.desc: One day, Hyun-joon, a policeman who lives with his mother and his daughter, attains a superpower after getting struck by the lightning. After the incident, Hyun-joon realizes that there are others who have been going through the same situation with him, and gets involved with unexpected situations. Will he be able to succeed both, as a father who struggles with the relationship with his daughter, and as a cop with a superpower who is eager to catch an evil criminal.

programme.title: 色戒
programme.desc: Set in the deceptive Japanese occupied Shanghai in 1942. Wang is recruited to seduce the head of the regime's secret police, enrapture herself in the affair, and end his life.(n)

programme.title: 鬼請你睇戲
programme.desc: GV Broadway Cinema is the oldest cinema in the city and it'll be demolished soon. The cinema has always been dark and cold, so it became the last place for the ghost to stay. Yang Yang found a temporary job in the cinema. But this is the last day of his job, so he brings his girlfriend Yiu-yiu to watch the last movie, not realizing a horrible nightmare is coming..(n)

programme.title: 流浪之月
programme.desc: In a park on a rainy evening, a 19-year-old university student, Fumi, offers an umbrella to a soaking wet 10-year-old girl, Sarasa. Realizing her reluctance to go home, Fumi lets her stay in his place, where she spends the next two months in peace. They take each other's hands and seem to have finally found their place in the world until Fumi is arrested for kidnapping. Fifteen years later, the lonely two are reunited both still suffering from the stigma as the victim and perpetrator of “a pedophile case”. Will the society give a place to their unshakable bond they have formed.(n)

programme.title: 芳香之城傳奇
programme.desc: Princess Su of the magical Aroma City falls to earth and in love with Jiang. But as Jiang is no angel, there is an infernal contract out on his soul..(n)

programme.title: 孤島診療所 2022
programme.desc: Shikina Island is a beautiful island located on the western edge of Japan. Kensuke Goto (Dr. Coto) came from Tokyo 19 years ago to this isolated island, 6 hours by ferry from the mainland. Since then, he has been the only doctor on the island and has borne the responsibility for the lives of all its residents. Over the years, the islanders have come to trust Coto, and Coto has come to trust them. He has become an irreplaceable presence and family member to all. A few years ago, he married Ayaka Hoshino, a nurse who has supported Coto for many years, and Ayaka is now seven months pregnant. Together with Ayaka's parents, Shoichi and Masayo, fisherman Gori Hara, former head fisherman Shigeo and his friends, Mariko, who runs a bar, and Wada, who helps out at the clinic, they live a peaceful life on the island. Now in 2022, Shikina Island, like many other rural areas in Japan, is experiencing depopulation and aging. Despite this somewhere in the back of their minds the islanders.(n)

programme.title: 迷城
programme.desc: When former cop-turned-bar owner T-man Kwok (Louis KOO) befriends a drunken woman at closing hours (TONG Liya), they soon find themselves targeted both by her former lover-a high-powered Hong Kong attorney-and the thugs (CHANG Hsiao-Chuan) he employs. Once Kwok's underachieving half-brother (Shawn YUE) and a suitcase full of tainted cash enter the picture, the chase turns deadly, with the brothers' tense family history coming to the surface as Kwok finds himself torn between the triads and his former police colleagues.(n)

programme.title: 特務打爆機
programme.desc: No one can stop us from going to Hawaii. Mi-yeong, an ordinary lady who sells donuts, goes on her first family trip. However, their excitement doesn't last so long. Strange people are on board with them and tries to hijack the plane. In the moment of emergency, an unexpected hero appears to save the plane. Will her dreamlike vacation come true.(n)

programme.title: 瘦身男女
programme.desc: Mini Mo becomes an fatty when her boyfriend went abroad ten years ago. She meets Fatso in the time of adversity. When Fatso learns the true story behind Mini's depression..(n)

programme.title: 你好，之華
programme.desc: There are fidgety encounters, like there are uncomplicated goodbyes. All Yuan Zhinan left behind on the morning of her departure from the world was a letter and an invitation to a school reunion. Attending the reunion in lieu of her late elder sister, Zhihua accidentally ran into Yin Chuan, her crush of her youth. As old memories are evoked to a present time of reshuffled relationships, as correspondences travel through different contexts and times, Zhihua slowly uncovers the intricate story among the trio.(n)

programme.title: 心裏美
programme.desc: Mr. K.K. Ho, is a leading “star tutor” with remarkable achievements. Lee Lung Kei , the stingy boss and principal of the cram school, regards Mr. Ho as a trump card. Chloe, a traditional high school teacher, has always tried her best in teaching. Chloe despises K.K.'s teaching methods and refers to them as deviant. The two of them give tit for tat in class. Their conflict leads to K.K.'s appreciation for Chloe. He gives her flowers as an apology, but Chloe never accepts. He finds out Chloe is the daughter of Principal Lee. When she was young, she witnessed her mother being bullied and died by accident. That is why she deeply hates her father and refuses to get in touch with him. K.K. with wisdom and courage, who breaks through all the obstacles to pursue Chloe but also takes into account the father-daughter relationship. However, he learns Chloe has genetic heart disease and what's worse, due to her diligent teaching for years, the doctor believes that she could only live for.(n)

programme.title: 不義之戰
programme.desc: Twenty years ago, Inspector Tam Ka Ming, Hei and Special Female Force team Madam, Shirley and a group of commandos started a secret operation to chase a group of gangster across the border of Hong Kong. This led to a large and drawn-out firefight between the police and gangsters, resulting in Shirley and a number of commandos killed in operation. The incident caused Inspector Tam and Madam Fong having a nightmare in these twenty years. Twenty years later, an escort operation bringing Inspector Tam and Madam Fong with four new-generation Special Female Force teammate Alma, Zi Han, Sheila, and Tong Yu to Macau, a group of gangster stormed the operation and they find Hei is still alive..(n)

programme.title: 爆谷製造 -MIRROR之怪盜任務
programme.desc: Movie WE 12, starring Hong Kong's big hit boy group MIRROR, presents a passionate story full of anime vibe using fun and fresh approach. As it is MIRROR's first time starring a movie in full team of 12, the idols must have interesting behind the scene stories to share. Have there been any obstacles though? And how does 'Kaito Association' in the movie reflect MIRROR's relationship in real life.(n)

programme.title: 天降異能必有用: 12怪盜
programme.desc: In the world, which is ordinary yet a little bit extraordinary, there is an underground organization called the 'The League of Kaito'. Their members silently guard the social order and peace. Within the organization, there are 12 geniuses, each with their own unique skills. Kaito Ian is good at planning, Kaito KT is a master of hypnosis, Kaito Stanley is skilled in eavesdropping, Kaito A.Lo is most adaptable, Kaito Edan is excellent in abseiling, Kaito Jer can instantly disguise himself, Kaito Tiger knows how to read lips from a distance, Kaito Alton is a world-class hacker, Kaito AK masters animal telepathy, Kaito Lokman is familiar with unlocking techniques, Kaito Frankie has the strongest sixth sense, and Kaito Jeremy has a natural super memory and can read and memorize large amounts of information at a glance. They are the star members of the League of Kaito. One day, they received instructions from Boss, to gather at headquarters to complete an important case that will a.(n)

programme.title: 片場職人 -麥兆輝
programme.desc: Graduated from acting major, Alan Mak has been cultivating in the film industry for over three decades and often serving as director or screenwriter. He created numerous remarkable films such as “Infernal Affairs” and “Overheard 3” that not only earned him notable recognition in the form of awards but also demonstrated his curiosity toward human nature. In this episode, he is going to revisit and dissect the film universe through his works.....(n)

programme.title: 金剛王：死亡救贖
programme.desc: When he was 8-years-old, Vajrasattva was among the children sold to the Temple of Hades. Forced by his captors to fight for food, he accidentally caused the death of his brother. He made a secret oath to take revenge. Many years pass and, as an adult, Vajrasattvah is the greatest assassin in the Temple. He escapes to China and joins the Southern Shaolin Temple where he receives spiritual enlightenment and vows to protect his own country against the Japanese. Meanwhile, the Temple of Hades have set up a branch in China. It hosts daily fight competitions, openly challenging Chinese fighters. Many Chinese warriors, including prisoners-of-war from various nations, are killed in the arena and photographic evidence spread across the country as propaganda to crush the Chinese spirit. The Temple of Hades begins buying children again, training them to become assassins against their fellow Chinese.To rescue the children, Vajrasattva enters the Temple and challenges their fiercest Hade.(n)

programme.title: 給自己的情歌
programme.desc: Suddenly learning she is terminally ill, 'Se-yeon' asks her husband, 'Jin-bong', the absurd task of helping her find her first love, and he unwillingly joins her search. Along their journey, 'Se-yeon' and 'Jin-bong' are reminded of the most glittering, beautiful moments of their lives.(n)

programme.title: 東京復仇者
programme.desc: Takemichi Hanagaki leads a dead-end life in a run-down apartment while working part-time at a job for a younger manager who treats him like an idiot. Then one day, he learns that a girl he used to date during his hooligan days in middle school, Hinata Tachibana, and her brother, Naoto, have been murdered by the Kanto area's most villainous hoodlums, Tokyo Manji. The very next day, Takemichi is standing on a train platform when he is suddenly pushed onto the tracks. But instead of dying, Takemichi is transported ten years into the past where he is reunited with Hinata's younger brother, Naoto. “10 years from now, Hinata and you will be killed” he tells Naoto, thus altering the future. Hinata still doesn't survive, but Naoto does, becoming a police detective. Returning to the present day, Takemichi recruits Naoto's help in returning to the past to crush Tokyo Manji and save his Hinata's life once and for all. All Takemichi needs to do to travel through time is to shake hands w.(n)

programme.title: 爆谷電影現場
programme.desc: Baogu At The Movie brings you the most exclusive behind the scenes of recent local blockbusters. The most true story and sincere conversation behind every piece of dreamwork.(n)

programme.title: 拳霸無銀用
programme.desc: Thongpoon wants to produce a movie by using his gift of martial art to be a leading actor. Without money, he joins a boxing gambling for finding funds, but at last he becomes a prizefighter unexpectedly.(n)

programme.title: 游龍戲鳳
programme.desc: It's hardly a coincidence that Sam is considered the most eligible bachelor in town. Not only is he a young, smart, and insightful entrepreneur with a coveted fortune, but he also happens to be a blithe spirit with a carefree attitude to life. However, every success has its price. Sam has already divorced three times and finds himself crawling back to the game of love sooner than he has expected. It is love at first sight when Sam chances upon a feisty, fast-talking woman with the odd name of Milan at a Macau casino. But the catch is, she is a part-time poker dealer and a full-time cabaret dancer, “careers” not exactly congruent with his station in life. Fallen in love against all odds, this mismatched couple soon makes headline in all media which turn Milan into an It girl overnight..(n)

programme.title: 30日求「分」大作戰
programme.desc: “I was perfect until God threw this woman into my life” JUNG-YEOL, the intelligent and handsome loser. “He's like a mosquito. Who knows why they exist?” NARA, the successful careerwoman born with a side of crazy. Despite being brought together by a cinematic encounter that led to their storybook romance, the two have now grown sick of each other's nutty and loserish ways, finally deciding to become perfect strangers again. But......with D-30 until they stamp their papers, a fateful accident inflicts amnesia on the star-crossed couple.(n)

programme.title: 窄路微塵
programme.desc: Under this flashy city, amidst the numbness of frustrations, what people are looking forward to is the glimmer of light that might change their lives. Chak, who runs a small cleaning company, barely takes over the cleaning work on his own to make a living. Hitting by the COVID-19 pandemic, small business closed down one by one. One day, a young single mother, Candy, comes to look for a job opportunity from Chak. She doesn't seem like a trustworthy person to Chak, unexpectedly, she helps Chak to resolve many difficulties at work. Life seems like get back on track. The morning sun never lasts a day, Chak's company is being accused, at the same time, his family is facing a nightmare as well, all his hopes are dashed to pieces, but they can still try their best to resist the oppression of life and support each other through this painful year.(n)

However, they found themselves being ambushed by a gang of teddy-boys headed by Robert who were used to be opponent of Ah Heung. It was Kee who fought independently against Robert's gang and saved Ah Heung from danger. After that, their heart-broken story begins..

It is their job to get Huang. Cindy happens to know her friend's father is the prosecutor in Huang's trial. She tries to help but Huang gets off by poisoning the prosecutor. Now Cindy is desperate. The police want to see her back in America. She wants to get Huang herself..

But suddenly there is a breakthrough in his career, for four managers of the company is recommending a promotion for him! Of course, there is a price behind this - Liang has to let them use his bachelor apartment for conducting love affairs! Soon this scandal travels to the ears of the general manager Mr. Lui..

Kam married Sam and moves to Shenzhen to look after Sam's karaoke business. However, being a karaoke manager does not suit Kam. At the same time, Sam is unfaithful and so Kam returns to the movie industry and once again becomes a stuntwoman..

programme.desc: King, the Con Man, is regarded as the successor of God of Gamblers. Dragon opts for gambling and approaches King, hoping to learn gambling tricks from him..

programme.title: 月黑風高
programme.desc: Michael Chow is the chief cop of Tai O, a small rural town on Hong Kong's outlying Lantau Island. When a local man turns up dead, urban hero cop Michael Wong is sent in to help out the locals... and what follows is a cultural clash that's both humorous and utterly entertaining! Wong is an SDU cop and takes to bullying the locals with tough and hard-handed ways, but his efforts only result in resentment and anger. It's Chow who gets what the odd residents of Tai O are about, and his lackadaisical attitude is just what's needed to handle the prickly locals. But it may take the skills of both men to solve this murder case! Though nominally a cop film, this unique creation is as much a comedy of cultural errors as a murder mystery.

The Revenge Fund set up by the trade lord kicks in. Whoever avenges the trade lord's death, killing the killer and the force behind him, will receive a reward of $1 billion. Tung is linked to high-maintenance TV personality Mindy, and Deborah is about to encounter a fitting fall from grace. Thanks to her mean-spirited behavior, she loses her job, her home (she and her father have a spat), and possibly her self-respect. Deborah and Tung encounter each other at the hospital, where Tung is visiting his mother and Deborah is staying (as in sleeping on the floor) with her sister. programme.title: 原始武器
programme.desc: A brutal murder occurs in the moonlight: a masked killer and his two accompanies execute a couple in an extremely sadistic way. Organized crime investigators KWAN, LEE and LING start to investigate into the case promptly. LING has a charming character and both men are in love with her. LING faces a dilemma and decides to give both men a fair competition. No sooner have they resolved the love triangle that they face great disasters. On the wedding night of LING and LEE, three masked killers break into their house, slay LEE and force LING to engage in S. M..(n)

programme.title: 妖獸都市
programme.desc: Sometimes in the future...The world's humans co-exist in a delicate balance with highly evolved 'Creature', living beings who have taken on the physical form of humans and emulate human comportment. But in times of crisis, these creatures revert to their basic animalistic instincts...with corresponding beastlike behaviour..(n)

programme.title: 壞女孩
programme.desc: The first thing on notices about Yau is his strong hatred for mahjong. He had good reasons: his mahjong-playing mother refused to leave the gaming table to attend to his father who had been robbed. The father died as the result, of course. Being young and fancy-free, Yau goes to the beach with two friends to see if romance should drop on him. It does, and like a ton of bricks because he sees and falls for the beautiful Fong. It so happen Fong is a devoted mahjong player, but she has a sister who hates mahjong, Yau goes all out. He is first snubbed but later comforted by Fong in a gymnasium where he helps her dodge arresting traffic policemen. Fong tries her best to cover her addiction to mahjong and awkward situations come on fast and furious..(n)

programme.title: 富貴開心鬼
programme.desc: Hong Kong is in the grip of emigration fever. Everybody is either going to Canada or has put in the application. The Ling family – dad, mom, Shirley and sis, is no exception. They need money. So they held a sale of all the furniture. Mom is promised a fat sum by the landlady if she can manage to dislodge tenant David, who happens to be Shirley's boyfriend. Leaking gas, however, kills the Lings. Their souls want to go to Canada but are turned back because of insufficient funds..(n)

programme.title: 拳王
programme.desc: Silent classmate Ming, an ambitious boxing addict, decides to learn boxing in Thailand after a technical knockdown in a contest which he was confident of winning. By witnessing the rigorous training on the spot, he not only develops the physique of a boxer but enhances the dignity and dauntless spirit of the boxer in a tournament. Tak is another young upcoming boxer. He learned Chinese martial arts from his father since childhood. Not wanting to be cooped up in the narrow confines of boxing only, he undergoes hard training in Thai boxing in a gym, hoping to widen the boxing horizon..(n)

programme.title: 跛豪
programme.desc: The story of Ho, a chinese peasant/slave worker who escapes to Hong Kong and becomes one of the most feared crime bosses in Hong Kong.(n)

programme.title: 秋天的童話
programme.desc: Lee Kay goes to college in New York City and also to visit her boyfriend Dickson. The one to meet her at the airport is a distant relative Boat Head..(n)

programme.title: 追鬼七雄
programme.desc: Long ago in China, corpses are supposed to be able to follow orders given by a leader and 'jump' to their respective burial places. However, some drug dealers use this method to smuggle opium. Things are going well until the local aristocrat, Master Miu, murders a singer's husband as he fails in attempting to rape her. He asks the corpse leader to take the body away. Then, one of the members from drug dealers is killed mysteriously. When the drug dealers try to go after the case, they find a strange corpse sucking in a huge snake in an old tower. Many members are killed as they try to get out in time..(n)

programme.title: 天涯海角
programme.desc: Kelly, suffers from leukemia, encounters a sailor named Michael who comes from the North Sea of Scotland. Love comes and goes until Takeshi comes to her life..(n)

programme.title: 殭屍家族
programme.desc: Antique dealer Kwok roams the countryside with his two assistants searching for rare objects. One day they fall into the cellar of a shrine. There they find three vampires, all rendered harmless by talismans. Kwok takes Sonny Vampire to town, but when the talisman is removed accidentally, the vampire escapes and is being hidden by 6-year-old Chia Chia then. Papa Vampire and Mama Vampire are awakened too when the talismans fall off. Dr. Lin and reporter Ha decide to help stop the vampires from killing people..(n)

programme.title: 衛斯理之霸王卸甲
programme.desc: This is a film about one of the practical metaphysics of the Orient - Geomancy. The Orientals believe fervently that a good burial site endows fame and fortune on its descendants. When the story begins, two geomancers are roaming Indochina's wilderness trying to find the dream grave site. They find The Conqueror, a site generating wealth and power - also a bloodbath. Nguen wants it but Wei wants no bloodbath. They have a fight. Wei escapes by the skin of his teeth. Wei rewards the poor man who saved him by finding him a good grave site. Many years later, Anna who is believed to be the daughter of the poor man, heads an American computer empire. Wei's son, Wisely, is a famous traveler. The girl asks him to go to Indochina to trace their roots..(n)

programme.title: 殭屍醫生
programme.desc: Dr. Chiang, a Hong Kong surgeon, finds himself surrounded by beautiful girls in an old castle. Little does he realize these are the Count's vampire girls. He has a one-night stand with Alice who bites him while he was unaware. He gradually assumes the characteristics of a vampire. Alice breaks with the Count and goes to Hong Kong to save Dr. Chiang. That gets him into hot water with his girlfriend May..(n)

programme.title: 影后曼人迷: 急凍奇俠
programme.desc: Yuen Biao and Yuen Wah are two Ming Dynasty adversaries who topple into an ice chasm, only to be thawed out in modern day Hong Kong.(n)

programme.title: 胭脂扣
programme.desc: Rouge stars Leslie Cheung as Chen, the never-do-well son of a wealthy and powerful family, who defiantly falls head over heels in love with prostitute Fleur in the 1930's. Disowned and despised, the hopeless couple makes a suicide pact – but Chen finds himself unable to carry through with it..(n)

programme.title: 皇家戰士
programme.desc: When a Hong Kong policewoman, a Japanese Interpol agent and an air security officer botch a plane hijacking attempt by a militia fanatic, his veteran friends vow revenge. In order to stop the terrorist attacks and also to save their own lives, the three heroes must team up once again to fight their gun-toting adversaries.(n)

programme.title: 夜車
programme.desc: They are the generation who work hard at living it up at the discos, in midnight car races and occasional fight. They are not happy with the world they live in but are determined to make the most of it. They go racing down the freeway in a stolen car. When stopping at the petroleum station, they find they don't have money. On the spur of the moment, they decide to rob the station. After a fight, King Kong is badly hurt and Cream kills a staff by accident. Bee runs away from the group, badly shaken and frightened by this traumatic experience..(n)

programme.title: 新上海灘
programme.desc: The Taiwan military officer, Hsu falls into the enemy's ambush, and floats to the Shanghai shore where he is saved by Ting Lik. Lik teams up with Kueng to try to make a fortune and soon they become famous in Shanghai. The Shanghai tycoon Fung try to eliminate other opponents with the help of Hsu and Lik. Later, Hsu discovers Fung is the mastermind of the ambush that killed all his fellow officials..(n)

programme.title: 殭屍醫生
programme.desc: Dr. Chiang, a Hong Kong surgeon, finds himself surrounded by beautiful girls in an old castle. Little does he realize these are the Count's vampire girls. He has a one-night stand with Alice who bites him while he was unaware. He gradually assumes the characteristics of a vampire. Alice breaks with the Count and goes to Hong Kong to save Dr. Chiang. That gets him into hot water with his girlfriend May..(n)

programme.title: 飛龍猛將
programme.desc: Hotshot lawyer is hired by a mysterious chemistry factory to dig up dirt on an inconvenient fishery seeking damaging court action. Sidekick Hung and professional crook Yuen swiftly sprint to Chan's aid. Ironically the gang finds their toughness softening in the face of two gorgeous ladies at the fishery. They inadvertently hit a center nerve of the chemical factory when they unmask the hideous facade of a narcotic syndicate.(n)

programme.title: 暗戰2
programme.desc: The mysterious figure Ken confronts Sang in a hostage situation and challenges him into a game of ransom. Sang is intrigued..(n)

programme.title: 人嚇人
programme.desc: Fatboy is a helper to Grand Uncle who is the town's high priest. They are now found in the ancestral shrine of the Mas working wonders. Fatboy is also being reprimanded by Grand Uncle for being rude to his fiancee, Yuen. The last of the Mas, the rich family in town, is back but Ma Lucho is coming home dead. Accompanying the body is a woman who claims to be Ma's wife and very much pregnant. But Fatboy knows his boyhood friend Ma couldn't be a husband because he was impotent..(n)

programme.title: 戀戰沖繩
programme.desc: Jenny wakes up and decides to leave her lover Sato, a triad boss. She takes Sato's ransom money to Tang, who has a diary with explicit details of Sato's triad activities.(n)

programme.title: 黃飛鴻鐵雞鬥蜈蚣
programme.desc: Wong Fei Hong investigates why lots of village girls have gone missing and discovers that it's organised by the law enforcer. A big fight ensures between Wong and the bad guys..(n)

programme.title: 著牛仔褲的鍾馗
programme.desc: Tsu, a police officer, has a happy life with his wife, who's pregnant. But one day when he gets a tip that a bank is about to be robbed, he rushes to it but killed. The hostage Gucci then holds the loot. Tsu becomes a vampire when a cat jumps on his body and is hit by lightning. Not until he went to the hospital did he realize he was dead and needs electric recharge to be alive. In order to keep his wife from being sad, he doesn't tell her the truth. Even when his best friend Mr. Big and Gucci find it out, he asks them to keep in secret. To get back the loot, the robbers seize both Gucci and Tsu's wife, forcing Tsu to bring the loot to exchange them..(n)

programme.title: 影后曼人迷: 求愛夜驚魂
programme.desc: Lung is a handsome young man. He has gift of the gab and is the best company to keep. Jane is a young talented reporter. She is devoted to her job. Lung and Jane seem to be ideally matched. But Jane, the famous TV reporter, has a lawyer boyfriend. And Lung is a mere taxi driver, just one of Jane's admirers. But Lung is determined to try. He gets to know Jane and gives her hot news tips. He organizes his cabbie friends into a radio news network, informing him all the happenings around the town. This works out at first, but sometimes they are led into ridiculous situation. Jane is slowly distancing herself form Lung. In desperation, Lung calls Jane saying he has the news of the century for her..(n)

programme.title: 魔唇劫
programme.desc: Bookworm professor Shiang Chin-Fei. During a picnic celebration, his female students are chewed apart by the moon monster that appears when the moon turns red. At first Chin-fei is a police suspect, but as the corpses mount, the cops realize there are supernatural forces at work. An archaeologist specializing in esoteric religions, a detective buddy, his ex-wife (now involved with the cop on the case) and the cops all assist in chin-fei's attempt to clear his name and solve the case. They travel to Cambodia to visit the Holy Virgin, princess of the High Wind Tribe..(n)

programme.title: Trucking Hell 第2季
programme.desc: In this episode a 40-ton lorry rammed full of scrap metal overturns and spills its steel load across a major A road during rush hour, and Lantern recovery op Steve Knight is called to the scene. 25 tonnes of metal must be removed from the lorry before it can be lifted and with a damaged 5th wheel, it’s a job that will push Steve and his team to the limit. At Crouch HQ there’s excitement in the air as the team give trucking superfan Chris and his disabled daughter, the ride of his life by taking him to his wedding in a big orange truck. Late at night, recovery op Snod is called to the side of the M69 to recover two crashed cars. With one on its side with the hand brake off, he must take care righting it to make sure it doesn’t roll into the passing traffic. It’s particularly tough job for Snod as his friend was killed on the same stretch of road whilst recovering a vehicle.

programme.title: Sumatra's Last Tigers 第1季
programme.desc: While tiger populations all around the world are crashing, tiger numbers in a remote nature reserve in Sumatra, Indonesia are increasing. Here even man killers are being rehabilitated and released into the wild. The man behind this unique conservation project is Indonesian tycoon, Tomy Winata. Tomy’s ambitious plan now includes releasing a tiger born in captivity into the wild, will it survive and can the experiment transform conservation practices and save the Sumatran tiger.

programme.title: Trucking Hell 第2季
programme.desc: In this episode a 40-ton lorry rammed full of scrap metal overturns and spills its steel load across a major A road during rush hour, and Lantern recovery op Steve Knight is called to the scene. 25 tonnes of metal must be removed from the lorry before it can be lifted and with a damaged 5th wheel, it’s a job that will push Steve and his team to the limit. At Crouch HQ there’s excitement in the air as the team give trucking superfan Chris and his disabled daughter, the ride of his life by taking him to his wedding in a big orange truck. Late at night, recovery op Snod is called to the side of the M69 to recover two crashed cars. With one on its side with the hand brake off, he must take care righting it to make sure it doesn’t roll into the passing traffic. It’s particularly tough job for Snod as his friend was killed on the same stretch of road whilst recovering a vehicle.

programme.title: 詩意中國民謠與詩歌的遠行
programme.desc: The sixth season of 'Poetic China' seamlessly weaves the tapestry of Chinese classical poetry with the adventurous spirit of travel, with music serving as the keystone. In collaboration with esteemed national artists, the series ventures across the breathtaking landscapes of our great nation-mountains and seas alike-to listen to the whispering winds and the lullabies of the ocean's depths. These experiences inspire the creation of healing songs that embody the unique charm, merging the rich legacy of Chinese musical traditions with the distinctive urban identity. The program showcases the contemporary urban healing trend through a timeless melody that resonates across the ages. With the solemn duty to 'communicate the beauty of life through poetry,' the show endeavors to cultivate 'cultural confidence among the Chinese people.' Anchored in the vibrant characteristics of Shenzhen, it forges a new television format that is youthful, avant-garde, and engaging.(n)

programme.title: 柚木家的四兄弟
programme.desc: 柚木一家由長男隼，沉著冷靜的次子尊，活力滿滿、凡事為兄弟著想卻有點笨拙的三子湊，以及因為可靠懂事又有遠見而被稱呼為「仙人」的四子岳所組成。自兩年前雙親突然過世後，他們四兄弟便開始相依為命的生活。即便偶爾會發生爭吵，他們還是熱鬧地度過每一天。本作品描繪.(n)

迎戰全國運動會 (四) - 行走十五運
programme.desc: 被譽為粵港澳大灣區的「綠色明珠」，惠州不僅是蘇東坡筆下的山水之城，坐擁得天獨厚的自然資源，還全力打造華南戶外運動之都。惠州在今屆全運會將會承辦跆拳道及滑板項目，為城市注入活力。. 今集節目請來香港跆拳道運動員黃靖楠，與曾經奪得2004年雅典奧運會跆拳道67公斤級金牌的前中國跆拳道運動員羅微，跟大家暢遊惠州：乘坐纜車到「岭南第一山」的國家5A級旅遊景區羅浮山飽覽秀麗風光、化身八段錦師傅感受動與靜的節奏、站在千萬畝茶園體驗炒茶之樂，一同走進惠州市體育運動學校交流跆拳道搏擊路上的苦與樂.

programme.title: 捨不得星星
programme.sub-title: 第八集：友情變質的概率
programme.desc: 餐廳，盛倪娜和程回的朋友尷尬地坐着，而程回卻不知所蹤，盛倪娜忍不住吐槽程回。唐漾參觀藍川鋼鐵廠，注意到李明偉的浮誇作風和藍川鋼鐵廠表面看似優秀、實則在行業內排名逐漸下降的事實.

programme.title: 鏗鏘集
programme.desc: 殘特奧會即將開幕，健兒踏上舞台的背後，有一群無名英雄默默支持。教練、父母、老師等以時間及情感陪伴殘特運動員在競賽場上奮鬥。政府加大資源投入，優化培訓系統，冀讓更多殘特人士投身運動，但他們需要各異，要培育出精英運動員又是否想像中容易?本集將會紀錄他們的奮鬥歷程，與支持者的無私奉獻。他們的故事，不僅展現體育精神，更是共融社會的體現.

programme.title: 睇得見。聽得到
programme.desc: 巴黎 #殘奧 羽毛球輪椅組銀牌得主 #陳浩源，於殘奧過後離開國際舞台，不用經常過著「飛人」生活，出外比賽。不過，陳浩源並沒有因此放慢腳步，積極裝備自己，重返校園生活。同時間，陳浩源更嘗試跳入電視螢幕，由以往受訪者變成節目主持，面對新的挑戰，跟以往比賽時的挑戰又有甚麼不同？他亦到不同地方演說分享積極推廣傷健共融，更成立一間共融學院，定期舉辦體驗活動給予肢體殘障，以及有特殊教育需要人士參與，期望大眾更加關注殘疾人士的需求。 今集主持Vita、Angel更會嘗試參與其中感受一下，又會與陳浩源一齊探討殘疾運動員轉型時要面對的挑戰。. #陳浩源. #羽毛球. #中年轉型. #殘疾運動員. #殘奧.

programme.title: 31看世界 – 史前系列：極地尋龍
programme.sub-title: 史前系列：極地尋龍 (下) Ancient Earth: Dinosaurs of the Frozen Continent
programme.desc: 第二集，勘探行動持續推進。我們將揭曉：1990年代「南極暴龍」冰冠龍（Cryolophosaurus）與長達7米的草食性動物——冰川龍（Glacialisaurus）的重大發現，如何讓這片曾被視為生命荒漠的冰原大陸，重新點燃世人的探索熱情；並呈現新證據，指出堅韌的原始哺乳動物水龍獸（Lystrosaurus）可能透過休眠熬過極地黑暗寒冬與劇毒氣候劇變；最終揭示六千六百萬年前，小行星撞擊地球後，南極恐龍與史前生物的真正命運歸宿。. In the second of two episodes, the expedition continues apace. We find out how the great discovery in the 1990s of the Cryolophosaurus, dubbed the T-Rex of Antarctica, and a 25-foot-long plant eater, the Glacialisaurus, lead to a renewed interest in a continent that was once thought to be largely devoid of life. And reveal how new evidence that a tough proto-mammal, Lystrosaurus, may have hibernated to survive dark polar winters and toxic climate upheaval; and, ultimately, reveal what happened to the Antarctic dinosaurs and prehistoric creatures after the infamous asteroid struck the earth 66 million years ago.

programme.title: 迎戰全國運動會 (四) - 行走十五運
programme.desc: 孫中山先生的故鄉——中山，是擁有豐富歷史文化的名城，城內風貌充滿獨特的歷史氣息；反之，與香港一橋之隔的海濱城市——珠海，科技正在高速發展。今屆全運會，中山市將會承辦棒球、壘球及五人制女子18歲以下組別籃球賽事，珠海則與香港及澳門攜手，舉辦跨越三地的公路自行車賽事，打破界限。. 曾獲中國職業棒球聯賽「盜壘王」的中山棒球運動員何銓豐，本集將與香港棒球代表隊副隊長鄭鎧霆，深入感受中山的歷史文化：體驗有著數百年歷史的醉龍舞表演、於聞名全國的熊貓棒球場切磋球技、品嚐最天然的「中山之甜」—神灣菠蘿。. 二人更走到充滿科技感的珠海，拜訪世界蹼泳冠軍李詠珊，彼此交流運動員的心路歷程之餘，亦探索珠海市的未來面貌.

programme.title: 我們的當打之年
programme.desc: 袁歌替谷嶠還了債，原來金錢是袁歌的上司傅梅借的。傅梅一向心疼袁歌，更給袁歌介紹了一位對象相睇。谷嶠想在上海重新開始事業，但因為沒有工作經驗，屢次求職失敗。袁歌和杜秉文一起去見客戶的路上，回憶起大學時期杜秉文給袁歌告白，結果害得袁歌出醜的事.

programme.title: 生活．健康．資訊．體育．港式速遞

programme.title: 生活．健康．資訊．體育．港式速遞
大江大河之歲月如歌
programme.sub-title: 第十四集：宋運輝幫助楊巡求情
programme.desc: 新機器被送到廠裏，幾項實驗終於迎來新轉機。梁凡帶著銀行和法院人員來到楊巡的商場將商場帳戶凍結，楊巡這才明白原來一切都是梁父設計的圈套。楊巡打電話向宋運輝求助，宋運輝認為楊巡已經丟失了誠懇守信的品質，需要看到他的態度再考慮是否幫他求情。楊巡十分懊悔.

programme.title: 大江大河之歲月如歌
programme.sub-title: 第十五集：彭陽廠研究取得階段勝利
programme.desc: 楊巡看著兩個舊廠區，想起和梁思申規劃的歐洲購物街計畫，決定要重啟它。經過彭陽廠的不懈努力，竹胺的研究有了很大的進展，竹胺的殺蟲性相比其他農藥具有很大優勢。未來將準備進行大田試驗，宋運輝準備向部裏提供一份階段性的成果報告。楊巡態度誠懇地和梁思申道歉.

programme.title: BobieLand
programme.sub-title: 第四十七集 - 「分享是友誼和快樂的另一個名字」
programme.desc: Bobieland 第四十七集-「分享是友誼和快樂的另一個名字」. 編導：蔡少傑. 大家為英雄舞台劇考試排練得如火如荼之時，眾人準備離開去休息，. 突然有人靜悄悄潛入Bobieland 偷走 Bobie俠斗篷及名牌⋯⋯. . 【故事時間】「我叫粗尾巴」. 星級媽媽鄭萃雯(karen)繼續帶來繪本「我叫粗尾巴」，這次的故事是「比賽上樹」，小老虎粗尾巴與朋友仔小熊黑黑，在玩耍其間又遇上小花貓花花，花花向小老虎粗尾巴發出爬樹挑戰，小老虎粗尾巴決定接受這次挑戰，究竟最後誰會贏得最後勝利.

programme.title: 小農夫大作物 新一彈
programme.desc: 這集的焦點是便當！我們會用北海道時令食材教大家製作好味，又顏色豐富的便當。北海道電視台的主播波多野裕太學會一起來參加便當教室，不知最終他是否能成功製作一個好味的便當呢.

programme.title: 捨不得星星
programme.sub-title: 第九集：我們以為是愛情，結果是兄弟
programme.desc: 盛倪娜遇到了準備夜跑的程回，助理總覺得程回對盛倪娜「別有用心」。匯商銀行把張志蘭項目作為宣傳，唐漾想用壹休上的探店視頻作為素材。碰巧蔣時延在志蘭小鹵拍攝，唐漾二話不說趕了過去.(c)

programme.title: 醫生與你 - 講飲講食講健康 II
programme.desc: 榮升媽媽後，美麗人妻連詩雅(Shiga)依然保持著令人稱羨的靚樣與 Fit 爆身型。究竟她坐月時最常吃什麼？Shiga對囡囡的飲食極為重視，小小年紀的Camila又最愛吃什麼？為何廚師主持Mabel 都大讚Shiga為「隱世健康廚神」？心臟科醫生則講解肥胖與心血管疾病的關係。. 鴿肉富蛋白質、鐵質又易吸收，一鴿勝九雞。論乳鴿，中山石岐馳名中外，識食專員親身到當地養鴿場，了解優質乳鴿是如何養成的。大廚 Mabel創意炮製一道中西合璧的「羊肚菌菠菜乳鴿釀飯」，教大家將傳統補品食材變成美味與營養並重的精緻菜式。. 主持：鄭萃雯(Karen)、Mabel . 嘉賓：連詩雅(Shiga)、譚礎璋醫生（瑪麗醫院內科顧問醫生/心臟科專科.

programme.title: 迎戰全國運動會 (四) - 行走十五運
programme.desc: 作為第十五屆全國運動會廣東賽區的重要組成部分，雲浮和肇慶將承辦多項賽事。雲浮將舉辦曲棍球比賽，而肇慶則承辦體操、柔道及足球(女子18歲以下組)比賽。中國香港競技體操運動員黃曉盈及中國田徑運動員譚秋嬌特意走訪兩個賽區，體驗當地的體育精神與文化魅力。. 二人與雲浮當地的曲棍球隊員展開交流，學習曲棍球技巧。譚秋嬌在第十四屆全運會田徑女子三級跳遠比賽中獲得金牌，而黃曉盈是首位代表中國香港出戰奧運的女子體操運動員，二人有不少的運動心得跟隊員分享。. 雲浮素有「石都」之稱，兩位運動員更在當地非物質文化遺產傳承人的指導下，體驗了獨具特色的石雕工藝，感受這一傳統藝術的精髓。. 黃曉盈與譚秋嬌更深入了解肇慶蓬勃發展的毽球運動，感受這項運動的獨特魅力。作為體操運動員，黃曉盈還特別與前中國體操隊代表及世界冠軍－楊伊琳會面，二人共同指導當地小體操運動員，分享職業生涯的心路歷程.

programme.title: 31看世界 - Gordon Ramsay 瘋味之旅 4
programme.desc: 廚神 Gordon Ramsay 遊歷景色攝人的佛羅里達群島，在這個外號「海螺共和國」的地方，熱情洋溢的當地居民挑戰他，要他全情投入當地文化，於是他穿梭海洋，沿途向多位行內人取經，親身捕捉龍蝦、蟹和各式魚類，最後在終極廚藝比併中，與當地一位作風大膽的著名廚師兼釀酒師一較高下。. 雙語廣播： 粵語/英語 (電視版 及 網上版) . 播出時間： (首播) 2025年12月9日 星期二 晚上10時. . Gordon Ramsay explores the stunning Florida Keys, where vibrant locals challenge him to embrace the Conch Republic’s way of life. He traverses shimmering seas, gathering insider tips along the way, as he gets up close and personal with lobsters, crab and fish before facing off against daredevil chef and rum distiller Paul Menta at the final cook. . programme.title: 捨不得星星
programme.sub-title: 第九集：我們以為是愛情，結果是兄弟
programme.desc: 盛倪娜遇到了準備夜跑的程回，助理總覺得程回對盛倪娜「別有用心」。匯商銀行把張志蘭項目作為宣傳，唐漾想用壹休上的探店視頻作為素材。碰巧蔣時延在志蘭小鹵拍攝，唐漾二話不說趕了過去.

programme.title: 醫生與你 - 講飲講食講健康 II
programme.desc: 榮升媽媽後，美麗人妻連詩雅(Shiga)依然保持著令人稱羨的靚樣與 Fit 爆身型。究竟她坐月時最常吃什麼？Shiga對囡囡的飲食極為重視，小小年紀的Camila又最愛吃什麼？為何廚師主持Mabel 都大讚Shiga為「隱世健康廚神」？心臟科醫生則講解肥胖與心血管疾病的關係。. 鴿肉富蛋白質、鐵質又易吸收，一鴿勝九雞。論乳鴿，中山石岐馳名中外，識食專員親身到當地養鴿場，了解優質乳鴿是如何養成的。大廚 Mabel創意炮製一道中西合璧的「羊肚菌菠菜乳鴿釀飯」，教大家將傳統補品食材變成美味與營養並重的精緻菜式。. 主持：鄭萃雯(Karen)、Mabel . 嘉賓：連詩雅(Shiga)、譚礎璋醫生（瑪麗醫院內科顧問醫生/心臟科專科.

programme.title: 迎戰全國運動會 (四) - 行走十五運
programme.desc: 作為第十五屆全國運動會廣東賽區的重要組成部分，雲浮和肇慶將承辦多項賽事。雲浮將舉辦曲棍球比賽，而肇慶則承辦體操、柔道及足球(女子18歲以下組)比賽。中國香港競技體操運動員黃曉盈及中國田徑運動員譚秋嬌特意走訪兩個賽區，體驗當地的體育精神與文化魅力。. 二人與雲浮當地的曲棍球隊員展開交流，學習曲棍球技巧。譚秋嬌在第十四屆全運會田徑女子三級跳遠比賽中獲得金牌，而黃曉盈是首位代表中國香港出戰奧運的女子體操運動員，二人有不少的運動心得跟隊員分享。. 雲浮素有「石都」之稱，兩位運動員更在當地非物質文化遺產傳承人的指導下，體驗了獨具特色的石雕工藝，感受這一傳統藝術的精髓。. 黃曉盈與譚秋嬌更深入了解肇慶蓬勃發展的毽球運動，感受這項運動的獨特魅力。作為體操運動員，黃曉盈還特別與前中國體操隊代表及世界冠軍－楊伊琳會面，二人共同指導當地小體操運動員，分享職業生涯的心路歷程.

programme.title: 我們的當打之年
programme.sub-title: 第四集：谷嶠成功應徵第一份工作
programme.desc: 谷嶠為了能成功去SPA館上班，開始熬夜做功課，結果第二天面試時，主管只看她的臉蛋和身材，就讓她第二天來上班，但谷嶠還是為能擁有第一份工作而開心。袁歌打電話給醫生，說她按照醫生的建議吃藥、飲食等，但病情沒有好轉，醫生建議袁歌談場戀愛，刺激雌激素的分泌.

大江大河之歲月如歌
programme.sub-title: 第十六集：彭陽廠研究再遇難題
programme.desc: 竹胺的試驗出現問題，可能是陽光造成了竹胺光解，但如何解決這個問題眾人都毫無頭緒。宋運輝聯繫了南京化工研究院。宋運輝拜訪研究院推薦的專家，專家建議是尋找其他合適的組合取代對日光敏感的成份以提高竹胺的光穩定性，但這個方法至少要半年的時間.

programme.title: 大江大河之歲月如歌
programme.sub-title: 第十七集：雷東寶註冊商標事件被揭露
programme.desc: 宮新鳴到雷正山家探望，雷正山堅持自己沒有拿回扣，還向宮新鳴揭露了雷東寶讓自己把雷霆商標註冊到小雷家村的事，宮新鳴大為震驚。宮新鳴向雷東寶挑明自己知道商標的事情，並讓雷東寶提條件把商標換到縣裏，雷東寶拒絕，表示不相信縣裏的人，自己需要一條後路.

programme.title: BobieLand
programme.sub-title: 第四十八集 - 「分享是友誼和快樂的另一個名字」
programme.desc: Bobieland 第四十八集-「分享是友誼和快樂的另一個名字」. 編導：蔡少傑. 大家又回到Bobieland繼續為英雄舞台劇考試排練，寶欣姐姐卻發現 Bobie俠斗篷及名牌被人弄得骯髒不堪，此時小隊長薯片承認是他拿走了斗篷及名牌，更不小心弄髒了，眾人了解事情後，相約另一天再排練。. 【More More魔術see】. Magic Kevin 帶來一整個動物園，協助他表演樸克牌魔術，而且更和小朋友一起變了一個關於名字的魔術。. 【手作EASY JOB】. 園長Sarah姐姐、連同薯片和希兒，決定用紙杯為大家重現繪本內的三個主角～小老虎粗尾巴、小熊黑黑和小花貓花花，更可愛的是～它們會到處跑動呢.

programme.title: 小農夫大作物 新一彈
programme.desc: 今集的嘉賓是棒球旁述兼電視藝員岩本勉。他會一起幫忙收割石狩市的西蘭花。節目中他會試吃用鹽水煮的西蘭花。石狩西蘭花因為溫差的關係，味道特別甜美，適合配搭各種美食.

programme.title: 捨不得星星
programme.sub-title: 第十集：一聲漾哥，一輩子漾哥
programme.desc: 蔣時延受張志蘭的剩飯美食啟發，發起了「剩飯大挑戰」，壹休公司內，員工對蔣時延與唐漾的關係感好奇，蔣時延怕給唐漾造成負擔，主動澄清。未想唐漾聽到這話，心中湧起深深的失落.(c)

programme.title: 迎戰全國運動會 (四) - 行走十五運
programme.desc: 這一站我們來到了廣東省的汕頭和汕尾，別看兩座城市名字很相似，實際上它們之間相距100多公里。在十五運當中，汕頭承辦了沖浪及女子手球項目，汕尾承辦了帆船帆板項目。. 今集請來2015年世界帆板錦標賽冠軍，前中國帆板代表陳佩娜，作為土生土長汕頭人，她將帶領香港女子手球運動員鄔梨鈴Hardi，暢遊這座朝氣蓬勃、歷史悠久的城市：體驗融合舞蹈、戲曲跟武術元素的廣東潮汕地區傳統民俗舞蹈－英歌舞、品賞汕頭美食。亦會到汕頭體育中心體育館，觀賞手球測試賽之如，更讓Hardi率先踏足十五運會女子手球項目賽場！. 佩娜亦會帶大家到汕尾，參觀十五運會帆船帆板項目賽場－廣東海上項目訓練中心，了解帆船帆板項目籌備情況，Hardi更有機會在世界冠軍的指導下學習滑浪風帆。在汕尾紅海灣斜陽的襯托下，兩位一同分享運動員的苦與樂.

programme.title: 31看世界 - 維克托的極限清單
programme.sub-title: 維克托的極限清單 - 第四集：完成鐵人賽
programme.desc: 鐵人賽被視為世上其中一個最難的比賽：游泳3.8公里，騎單車180公里與及42公里的馬拉松組成。 Victor在留院期間向自己承諾，康復後要有能力參加。 這一天終於來到。Victor他總共有八個月時間準備，期間要通過嚴厲的體力和意志訓練。 負責訓練他的是傑出三項賽運動員: Antoine Scortatore。他不僅是出色的跑手，也和Victor一樣要面對自己的疾病。協助Victor 的，還有前三項鐵人賽世界紀錄保持者Benjamin Sanson。Victor要發揮小宇宙，在賽事中回應自己的承諾。這是一次身心的旅程，也是超越自我的奮門歷程。 雙語廣播： 粵語/法語 (電視版) 播出時間： (首播) 2023年9月11日 星期一晚上10時30分 The Ironman race is considered one of the toughest races in the world: a triathlon consisting of a 3.8km swim, 180km bike ride and a marathon. When Victor was in the hospital, he made a promise to himself that one day, despite his tuberculosis, he would be able to complete this hellish race. And that day came. Victor has never ridden a bike, can't swim more than 50m and has never participated in a single race in his life. . And he has eight months to get ready. He will have to undergo a relentless physical and mental training. To take charge of his training: Antoine Scortatore, an exceptional triathlete who is not only an excellent runner, but who, like Victor, has had to face illness. Alongside this coach, former triathlon world record holder Benjamin Sanson, doctors and commando instructors, Victor will have to dig deeper than ever to keep his promise for the final race. A physical, mental and above all human journey with effort and surpassing oneself as a common thread. Bilingual: Cantonese/ French (TV Version) Time: (First run) 2023.09.11 MON 10:30pm.

programme.title: 我們的當打之年
programme.sub-title: 第五集：袁歌嘗試初次約會
programme.desc: 谷嶠在SPA傳單上寫了自己的電話，在街上發傳單，卻意外被大學同學于可心撞到。谷嶠回到SPA館，又被主管刁難。袁歌收到玫瑰網的相親安排，但當天，袁歌忘了相親這件事。袁歌喝多了，被路過的鄭晉男帶上車。鄭晉男為了追袁歌費煞苦心，袁歌終於答應和鄭晉男約會.

31看世界 - 維克托的極限清單
programme.sub-title: 維克托的極限清單 - 第四集：完成鐵人賽
programme.desc: 鐵人賽被視為世上其中一個最難的比賽：游泳3.8公里，騎單車180公里與及42公里的馬拉松組成。 Victor在留院期間向自己承諾，康復後要有能力參加。 這一天終於來到。Victor他總共有八個月時間準備，期間要通過嚴厲的體力和意志訓練。 負責訓練他的是傑出三項賽運動員: Antoine Scortatore。他不僅是出色的跑手，也和Victor一樣要面對自己的疾病。協助Victor 的，還有前三項鐵人賽世界紀錄保持者Benjamin Sanson。Victor要發揮小宇宙，在賽事中回應自己的承諾。這是一次身心的旅程，也是超越自我的奮門歷程。 雙語廣播： 粵語/法語 (電視版) 播出時間： (首播) 2023年9月11日 星期一晚上10時30分 The Ironman race is considered one of the toughest races in the world: a triathlon consisting of a 3.8km swim, 180km bike ride and a marathon. When Victor was in the hospital, he made a promise to himself that one day, despite his tuberculosis, he would be able to complete this hellish race. And that day came. Victor has never ridden a bike, can't swim more than 50m and has never participated in a single race in his life. . And he has eight months to get ready. He will have to undergo a relentless physical and mental training. To take charge of his training: Antoine Scortatore, an exceptional triathlete who is not only an excellent runner, but who, like Victor, has had to face illness. Alongside this coach, former triathlon world record holder Benjamin Sanson, doctors and commando instructors, Victor will have to dig deeper than ever to keep his promise for the final race. A physical, mental and above all human journey with effort and surpassing oneself as a common thread. Bilingual: Cantonese/ French (TV Version) Time: (First run) 2023.09.11 MON 10:30pm.

programme.title: 2025/26學年 - 慶祝中華人民共和國成立76周年暨紀念中國人民抗日戰爭勝利80周年「心繫家國」聯校國民教育活動啟動禮 (五分鐘精華版)
programme.sub-title: 2025/26學年 - 慶祝中華人民共和國成立76周年暨紀念中國人民抗日戰爭勝利80周年「心繫家國」聯校國民教育活動啟動禮 (五分鐘精華版)
programme.desc: 2025/26學年官立學校，將與東華三院、保良局、中華基督教會香港區會、九龍樂善堂、天主教香港教區、香港聖公會，六個辦學團體及多個學校議會，攜手合作，共同推展2025/26學年「心繫家國」聯校國民教育活動，加強學生的文化自信同國民身份認同，培養家國情懷。. 啟動禮當日共有五個表演項目，以聯校中樂表演揭開序幕，再由署理教育局局長施俊輝博士致辭，勉勵大家踴躍參與來年的聯校活動，培養同學的家國情懷.(c)

programme.title: 捨不得星星
programme.sub-title: 第十一集：命中註定的緣分
programme.desc: 幫唐漾處理傷口時，蔣時延忽然靠近的距離，讓唐漾不知作何反應。盛倪娜直播時遭遇黑粉圍攻，程回解決了黑粉的惡意留言，盛麗娜對程回刮目相看。程回拜託盛倪娜給朋友簽名，卻被助理誤解為給自己簽.

programme.title: 政正關你事 - 照顧者們
programme.desc: 何先生與太太Connie年輕時於澳洲認識，二人皆任職餐飲業，曾於多個大型活動中出任大廚。夫妻二人亦曾在澳洲開設餐館，兩口子一同打拼。二人其後搬到洛杉磯生活，何先生繼續任職餐飲業，Connie則沒有再工作。. 生活本應如常，直至Connie開始出現病徵。起初二人會因Connie的善忘和情緒不穩而出現紛爭，何先生認為情況可能跟Connie的更年期有關，遂帶Connie到當地求醫，但醫生的診斷認為Connie的情況沒有不妥，只叫他們着手改變生活方式和習慣。. 為得到更適切的治療，何先生最後決定帶同Connie搬回香港。經香港的醫生診斷， Connie證實患上早發性認知障礙症及抑鬱症。Connie未滿60歲已出現性格改變、健忘等病徵，時至今日(64歲)已失去大部分語言能力和行動能力，需要全天候照顧。. 對何先生而言，由外地搬回香港，由一名大廚變成一名保安，這些都不是難以適應的地方，只要看見太太過得開心，自己便會開心。他最大的心願，就是自己要比太太長命，因為他害怕自己一旦先離開世界，沒有人可以像他一樣貼身照顧太太.

programme.title: 鏗鏘集
programme.desc: 「YouTuber」取代醫生、律師成為新世代最嚮往的職業。有調查顯示，超過三成青少年將內容創作者視為理想職業。這種轉變不僅顛覆大眾對傳統「高尚職業」的認知，更凸顯新一代對「成功」的定義，已從社會地位轉向自我實現。 進入數碼年代，工作不再有地域甚至時間限制，新世代更著重職業的自主性，令「打工」變得不再吸引。傳統企業面臨人才挑戰，僵化的職場文化、固定工時等，都令新世代卻步。 這場由數碼世界發起的革命，如何影響新世代價值觀及企業職場文化呢? 本集會一一探討.

programme.title: 迎戰全國運動會 (四) - 行走十五運
programme.desc: 孫中山先生的故鄉——中山，是擁有豐富歷史文化的名城，城內風貌充滿獨特的歷史氣息；反之，與香港一橋之隔的海濱城市——珠海，科技正在高速發展。今屆全運會，中山市將會承辦棒球、壘球及五人制女子18歲以下組別籃球賽事，珠海則與香港及澳門攜手，舉辦跨越三地的公路自行車賽事，打破界限。. 曾獲中國職業棒球聯賽「盜壘王」的中山棒球運動員何銓豐，本集將與香港棒球代表隊副隊長鄭鎧霆，深入感受中山的歷史文化：體驗有著數百年歷史的醉龍舞表演、於聞名全國的熊貓棒球場切磋球技、品嚐最天然的「中山之甜」—神灣菠蘿。. 二人更走到充滿科技感的珠海，拜訪世界蹼泳冠軍李詠珊，彼此交流運動員的心路歷程之餘，亦探索珠海市的未來面貌.

programme.title: 港樂 • 講樂
programme.desc: 上集《港樂‧講樂Pop Up》力臻、Michael C燃起現場氣氛，今集二人期間限定組合「米臻」再接再厲為大家獻唱合唱歌《做好戀愛的覺悟》，又與樂迷大玩遊戲。力臻亦接力唱出充滿J-pop風格新歌《2882點85 ✈》，以及富巴西風情Bossa Nova的《不打烊珈琲屋》，盡顯實力唱功。. . 主持. 阮頌陽. 嘉賓主持. 周卓盈. 歌曲：. 《做好戀愛的覺悟》. 《2882點85 ✈》. 《不打烊珈琲屋.(n)

programme.title: 中國 (第三季)
programme.desc: 殷商時期，對祖先的祭祀，不僅是信仰的表達，更是一種治國方式。家族倫理和尊重傳統，這兩個數千年來影響中國人行為的價值尺度，從此植根在我們的文化深處，慎終追遠的理念融入了每個中國人的家庭和生活.(n)

programme.title: 學人沙龍
programme.desc: 在這個推崇社交的時代，獨處為何成了一種需要隱藏的羞恥？本集將打破「一個人等於失敗」的刻板印象，帶你發現獨處的美好與力量。節目將從心理學角度剖析「孤獨羞恥感」的來源，探討為何我們會對獨處感到不安。臨床心理學家將分享如何透過「正念獨處練習」，將孤獨時刻轉化為自我對話的珍貴機會，建立更健康的自我關係，重新定義「一個人」的價值。. 主持:. 林家濠(哲學系講師). 梁重皿(臨床心理學家). 黃麗茵(藝術家). 李澄琳(澳洲註冊營養師).(n)

programme.title: 我們的當打之年
programme.sub-title: 第六集：谷嶠在同學會遭奚落
programme.desc: 袁歌和谷嶠去參加同學會，大家都在吹捧谷嶠長得漂亮還嫁得好，谷嶠沒辦法說自己離婚了並在做銷售。那天撞到谷嶠發傳單的于可心故意諷刺谷嶠。杜秉文突然出現，大家故意八卦起杜秉文和袁歌，杜秉文說袁歌有男朋友了。谷嶠趕到店裡，卻發現姍姍已經幫那位客戶辦會員卡了.(n)

programme.title: 生活．健康．資訊．體育．港式速遞
政正關你事 - 照顧者們
programme.desc: 何先生與太太Connie年輕時於澳洲認識，二人皆任職餐飲業，曾於多個大型活動中出任大廚。夫妻二人亦曾在澳洲開設餐館，兩口子一同打拼。二人其後搬到洛杉磯生活，何先生繼續任職餐飲業，Connie則沒有再工作。. 生活本應如常，直至Connie開始出現病徵。起初二人會因Connie的善忘和情緒不穩而出現紛爭，何先生認為情況可能跟Connie的更年期有關，遂帶Connie到當地求醫，但醫生的診斷認為Connie的情況沒有不妥，只叫他們着手改變生活方式和習慣。. 為得到更適切的治療，何先生最後決定帶同Connie搬回香港。經香港的醫生診斷， Connie證實患上早發性認知障礙症及抑鬱症。Connie未滿60歲已出現性格改變、健忘等病徵，時至今日(64歲)已失去大部分語言能力和行動能力，需要全天候照顧。. 對何先生而言，由外地搬回香港，由一名大廚變成一名保安，這些都不是難以適應的地方，只要看見太太過得開心，自己便會開心。他最大的心願，就是自己要比太太長命，因為他害怕自己一旦先離開世界，沒有人可以像他一樣貼身照顧太太.(n)

programme.title: 生活．健康．資訊．體育．港式速遞
中國 (第三季)
programme.desc: 殷商時期，對祖先的祭祀，不僅是信仰的表達，更是一種治國方式。家族倫理和尊重傳統，這兩個數千年來影響中國人行為的價值尺度，從此植根在我們的文化深處，慎終追遠的理念融入了每個中國人的家庭和生活.(n)

programme.title: 生活．健康．資訊．體育．港式速遞
大江大河之歲月如歌
programme.sub-title: 第二十集：東海爆炸事件原由
programme.desc: 雷東寶突然闖入面試並對雷正明破口大罵，怪他擅作主張。宋運輝到醫院看望東海廠爆炸事故中受傷的技術員，技術員反應洛達方不理會他們發現的異常。宋運輝讓研發處的人開會，不明白為何不在報告中提出是因為催化劑的矛盾，一分廠的技術人員私自改造線路才造成了爆炸.(n)

programme.title: 大江大河之歲月如歌
programme.sub-title: 第二十一集：宋運輝處理爆炸事件
programme.desc: 宋運輝和洛達談判後達成共識，洛達答應會開放自動化系統的技術，對一分廠的設備進行重新調試，宋運輝也承諾會開除違規操作的中方技術人員，並按洛達的報價購買催化劑。宋運輝安排被開除的工人去彭陽廠研發出東海自己的催化劑，替代洛達的高價產品.(n)

programme.title: BobieLand
programme.sub-title: 第五十集 - 「分享是友誼和快樂的另一個名字」
programme.desc: Bobieland 第五十集-「分享是友誼和快樂的另一個名字」. 編導：蔡少傑. 小隊長薯片得到了bobie俠角色後，用心排練及演出，可惜最後收到劇社通知信，得知第一輪面試也不入圍，眾人非常失望，薯片卻並不在意入圍成績，因為真英雄最重要就是懂得分享，就像Okie Bobie一樣。. . 【玩轉星期五】. 八位小朋友分成兩組，分別是爆谷隊和波板糖隊。遊戲「是非圈圈大作戰」. ，分別考驗各人的團隊合作精神、手眼協調和反應，究竟最後那一隊會勝出，得到Bobieland 遊玩券.(n)

programme.title: 動物童萌
programme.desc: 牠們或許不是最有魅力的小動物，但每隻都有自己獨有的吸引力，包括騎著媽媽的袋獾寶寶、漫遊非洲草原的鬣狗及在泥土中嗅探的農場小豬，印證了外表不重要，媽媽的愛才最重要.(n)

programme.title: 海鸚特攻隊
programme.desc: 奧圖幫派的一隻海鸚瘋狂愛上佩佩！無論她躲到哪裏，這傢伙總能神奇出現. .佩佩究竟能不能擺脫他呢.(n)

programme.title: 海鸚特攻隊
programme.desc: 小特、迪迪和佩佩收到一個包裹，他們設法藏起來！好奇的德仔能否找出這個神秘包裹內裏到底裝了什麼.(n)

programme.title: 捨不得星星
programme.sub-title: 第十二集：叫一聲漾哥甚麼都有
programme.desc: 蔣時延告訴唐漾當地的初雪一輩子一次，是命中註定的緣分。蔣時延雙手輕攏住唐漾耳朵替她擋住震耳的煙花響。兩人心照不宣地藏着「他們一起跨年了」的小秘密.(n)

programme.title: 跑者愛也
programme.desc: 第二集結伴跑. 〈跑者愛分享〉－蔡一智. 主持梁諾妍（Inez）與蔡一智（智哥）在大潭水務文物徑暢跑，享受雨後清新的大自然氣息！智哥熱愛運動，深信「健康，就是送給家人最好的禮物」。他以自身經驗鼓勵大家及早儲備健康資本，跑出快樂、跑出健康！. 〈跑者愛迷思〉－「超慢跑」有幾慢？. 近年流行的「超慢跑」，是一種低強度且輕鬆自在的有氧運動方式，速度介於步行與慢跑之間，有效降低關節負擔。這種跑步方式不僅適合不同年齡群組，更是初學者友善的入門運動，在家也能輕鬆練習，隨時隨地開啟健康之旅！. 〈結伴跑〉. 長跑運動員黃啟樂，自中學時受恩師啟蒙，踏上跑步旅程。一路奔跑，他在不同階段遇到許多生命中的良師益友，與及互相支持的另一半映潮。從校園操場到競技跑道，從跑步愛好者到專業運動員兼教練，每次結伴同行的經歷都給他帶來了深刻的啟發與成長.(n)

programme.title: 迎戰全國運動會 (四) - 行走十五運
programme.desc: 近年，深圳以驚人的追度書寫着城市經濟發展，科技產業更緊隨世界發展。今屆全運會，深圳作為全運會主要賽區，在場館加入不少科技設計元素，誓要打造一場科技時尚的辦賽體驗。深圳賽區將會承辦游泳、羽毛球及田徑(馬拉松)等傳統大項，亦會承辦排球(女子18歲以下組)及足球(男子20歲以下組、男子18歲以下組)等球賽，精益求精辦好賽事。. 今集，前香港羽毛球運動員葉姵延，與曾兩奪中國羽毛球大師賽冠軍的前中國羽毛球運動員王睜茗將會走進深圳：到訪舉辦羽毛球項目的比賽場館、踏足被稱為中國最高規格稱號的跨境馬拉松賽道、探訪科技企業體驗機器人的新技術，一同見證結合科技與文化的全運會.(n)

programme.title: 睇得見。聽得到
programme.desc: 巴黎 #殘奧 羽毛球輪椅組銀牌得主 #陳浩源，於殘奧過後離開國際舞台，不用經常過著「飛人」生活，出外比賽。不過，陳浩源並沒有因此放慢腳步，積極裝備自己，重返校園生活。同時間，陳浩源更嘗試跳入電視螢幕，由以往受訪者變成節目主持，面對新的挑戰，跟以往比賽時的挑戰又有甚麼不同？他亦到不同地方演說分享積極推廣傷健共融，更成立一間共融學院，定期舉辦體驗活動給予肢體殘障，以及有特殊教育需要人士參與，期望大眾更加關注殘疾人士的需求。 今集主持Vita、Angel更會嘗試參與其中感受一下，又會與陳浩源一齊探討殘疾運動員轉型時要面對的挑戰。. #陳浩源. #羽毛球. #中年轉型. #殘疾運動員. #殘奧.(n)

programme.title: 香港故事 ---近水留情
programme.desc: 大澳，水道縱橫，棚屋林立。潮汐塑造了村落的樣貌，也規範了居民的節奏。 畫家黃志泉，是漁民後代，有幸能上岸讀書，知識改變命運，在城市花花世界打滾大半生，最後又回歸家鄉，以創作及行動保育大澳文化，記錄人生中最美的樂土。 黃文光(四哥)是末代漁民，黃昏時分，河涌靜下來。划著舢舨過對岸，孫仔在岸邊呼喊。他自小在棚屋長大，以搖櫓駕艇討海維生。如今，他最大的快樂，是陪孫仔玩耍，並把手藝親手傳下去。 在對岸的村屋裡，四哥的女兒曉彤帶著家人從城市回流。她說，這裡沒有匆忙，多了鄰里間的問候，與父母隔水相望的自在。大澳的人情味，讓她放慢腳步，把日常過得更厚實。 大澳的另一邊-番鬼塘村，GenZ的岑朗軒(Lonny)，因一次參加了當地一個木工工作坊便愛上這地方，即使於屯門工作，也搬到大澳居住，一星期起碼有三天在大澳過住半農半職的生活，透過探索生活可能性之餘保留鄉村文化。 潮退潮漲，父輩的記憶、女兒的選擇、青年的嚮往，在大澳交織成一個慢活的氛圍。水道依舊流動，而每一代人，都在這裡找到屬於自己的生活。 . 節目播映:12月8日(星期一)晚上8時港台電視31.(n)

冰雪尖刀連
programme.sub-title: 第八集：萬里首次殺敵需要輔導
programme.desc: 萬里被野豬追趕而誤陷危機，被美軍追殺。隊友余從戎奮力保護，萬里艱難開槍，完成首次射擊。七連因位置暴露遭空襲，戰士們面臨嚴峻挑戰。萬里因殺敵心情沉重，梅生與千里對他輔導。行軍中，萬里暈倒，千里告誡萬里七連無活着的英雄.(n)

programme.title: 冰雪尖刀連
programme.sub-title: 第九集：千里率領增援營救戰友
programme.desc: 高原寒冷，指南針失效，七連迷路。千里憂心萬里，派雷公安慰。老肖等人與美軍交火獲勝，但遭空襲。千里分兵救援老肖，梅生趕往新興里。萬里違紀尋兄，老肖彈盡糧絕，千里帶着增援及時趕到，扭轉局勢。五連等待七連期間，被美軍發現，被迫提前發動進攻.(n)

programme.title: 學人沙龍
programme.desc: 一杯咖啡，能夠為一天工作提神打氣。由茶餐廳的一杯「飛沙走奶」，到今天走進咖啡店各式各樣源於世界各地烘焙出來的精品咖啡，一杯咖啡的意義好像轉變了很多。咖啡給了我們不僅是一陣醇厚的氣味，仿佛還有另一種文化生活。本集我們一起品味咖啡。. 主持：. 米哈(作家). 黃仲遠(註冊組織心理學家). 李思汝(視覺藝術家). 黃麗茵(藝術家). #咖啡文化#品味生活#茶餐廳#飛沙走奶#學人沙龍.(n)

programme.title: 生活．健康．資訊．體育．港式速遞
學人沙龍
programme.desc: 自1940年代開始，很多有抱負的上海建築師攜家帶眷南下香港，他們帶來創新的設計技巧，以及上海租界中西合璧的優雅，注入香港的街頭巷尾。為香港作為國際聞名-東西文化薈萃的大都會，奠定重要的根基。今集《學人沙龍》，我們一起探討上海建築師南下香港的故事！. 主持：. 潘浩倫(建築師). 董正綱(建築師). 黎雋維(英國註冊建築師). 郭美珩(香港綠色建築議會董事). #上海建築#海派南來#中西合璧#學人沙龍#黎雋維.(n)
